card.name: Device parts in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word for a piece of equipment (syringe, vial, port, nebulizer) or the word just before one, in step-by-step instructions for preparing or giving a product. The next word is usually a part or accessory such as pump, adapter, port, shield or mouthpiece.

modes.label: Equipment noun
modes.description: The last piece of a device name that is followed by another part name.
modes.example: place the 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP flush syringe in the sy<<ringe>> pump.

modes.label: Linking word before a part
modes.description: A small word such as the or a just before a named component of equipment.
modes.example: Instruct the patient to hold the nebulizer upright with<< the>> mouthpiece in his/her mouth.

modes.label: Port or container word
modes.description: A modifier word before port in IV transfer instructions.
